title: Meta's AI Teen Safety Net: Guardian Angel or Privacy Nightmare?
angle: Meta's new AI feature for alerting parents about teen self-harm chats sparks a crucial debate: Is it a necessary safety measure, or a dangerous erosion of privacy for vulnerable youth? We dig into the ethical tightrope Meta is walking.
rationale: This story hits a high emotional and ethical note, making it perfect for a strong, opinionated take that will drive engagement.

source_articles.title: Meta now alerts parents if their teen discussed suicide or self-harm with its AI chatbot
source_articles.excerpt: The updates come as Meta and other tech companies are facing scrutiny from regulators and parents around how AI chatbots respond to users in crisis, particularly teenagers.
